MASTER-OAGH robotic telescope  [1]  located in Mexico (OAGH National Institute for Astrophysics, Optics and Electronics) started inspect of the Fermi GRB260415.10 (trigger No 797912738,14h 44m 00.00s , +19d 21m 00.0s, R=6.21) errorbox  6140 sec after notice time and 6176 sec after trigger time at 2026-04-15 04:08:29 UT, with upper limit up to  19.8 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 58 deg. The sun  altitude  is -29.0 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = 62 deg., longitude l = 22 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3252523
